name: glasser-seo-audit
description: SEO audit of your own website on real data from Semrush, Ahrefs, DataForSEO and Serpstat, with no subscription to any of them. Give a domain and get technical and on-page health, rankings, keyword opportunities, competitors and keyword gaps, backlinks, search results and AI search visibility, scored and turned into a prioritised action plan. Run it again to see what changed. Pay per call through Glasser; failed calls cost $0.00.
